verdict.rationale: A public status page with historical incident postmortems is a fair question for a hosting and deployment platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a status page, an incident history or postmortems. The closest item, project performance and analytics tracking, is an adjacent feature, not a public status page.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing
